effects.title: Hello
effects.summary: The smallest effect: shells rising and breaking into peonies and gold chrysanthemums, every star on a closed-form path under drag and gravity, coloured by its metal salt, one instanced draw through the HDR tail. Every later effect starts from this shape.

effects.title: Crossette
effects.summary: Stars that split in four part way out, each split a small cross, so the burst branches. Still a pure function of time: each piece starts where its star split, at its velocity then plus a kick.

scorecard.fallback: A 10-bit AV1 loop, or the poster.
useCases: A hero for a celebration or an event

effects.title: Display over the river
effects.summary: A whole show over a river, after the hanabi taikai on the Sumida: every kind of shell in one programme, the smoke each break leaves drifting in the wind and lit from inside by later bursts, a far bank of dark buildings, and the river reflecting it all in streaks.

scorecard.fallback: A 10-bit AV1 loop of the programme, or the poster.
useCases: A full-bleed hero for a festival

effects.title: Glitter, crackle and strobe
effects.summary: The stars that are not steady: glitter sheds sparks that each flash once after a delay, crackle bursts into microstars with a pop, strobe blinks. Held under the flash rule, with a full-rate strobe as a gated preset.

scorecard.fallback: A 10-bit AV1 loop, or the poster.

effects.title: Palms and rings
effects.summary: Palms, a thick rising trunk and a few big comets shedding gold, and rings, stars round a circle in a plane at whatever tilt the shell broke at, so each is seen as an ellipse.

scorecard.fallback: A 10-bit AV1 loop, or the poster.
useCases: A hero for a celebration or an event

effects.title: Peony display
effects.summary: A drop-in fireworks display behind a hero: peonies, pistils and gold chrysanthemums from a looping programme of shells, every star a burning sphere slowed by the air, placed from a table of its flight, and coloured from its composition’s emission spectrum, in Display P3 where the screen has it.

scorecard.fallback: A 10-bit AV1 loop of the programme, or the poster.
useCases: A dark hero for a celebration or an event

effects.title: Shaped shells
effects.summary: Hearts, stars, smiles and a horse’s head as flat patterns of stars, or the page’s own SVG path, each seen at the angle its shell happened to break at: most come out skewed, as real ones do.

scorecard.fallback: A 10-bit AV1 loop, or the poster.
useCases: A playful hero for a celebration
A brand’s mark in the sky, honestly skewed

effects.title: Warimono
effects.summary: The Japanese round shell: a near-perfect sphere of densely packed stars, the double-petalled yae-shin with a pistil of another colour, and stars that change colour as they burn (henka).

scorecard.fallback: A 10-bit AV1 loop, or the poster.
useCases: A hero for a Japanese event

effects.title: Willow and kamuro
effects.summary: Gold willows and kamuro: heavy charcoal stars that burn for seconds and shed sparks that hang and fall, so each burst droops like a weeping willow. The slowest, calmest shell, and the one the motion check minds most, so it starts behind the gate.

scorecard.fallback: A 10-bit AV1 loop, or the poster.
useCases: A slow, calm hero for a celebration
